battlecards.why_selected: Lowest net effective rate (2.56%) versus incumbents, transparent pricing, strong customer service and implementation support.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pending final contract – Calibr indicated ability to lock rates for 3 years with annual price-cap below CPI.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used detailed 12-month interchange data from Chase to model exact savings; competitive tension from Braintree participation.
supplier_weaknesses: Requires data migration and token transfer
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-tokenization of stored cards, IT integration of Calibr APIs/SDKs, customer communication on processor change.
battlecards.notes: Estimated additional upside savings once interchange optimization is implemented.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Unwilling to reduce 2.86% effective rate; projected future increases.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: 30-year relationship created complacency; competitive bids exposed above-market pricing.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal due to month-to-month terms; primary effort is data/token migration.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Quote produced higher total cost (2.96% effective rate) and lacked detailed fee transparency.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as competitive pressure on Calibr and Chase.
supplier_weaknesses: Inability to quote precise interchange impacts

battlecards.why_selected: Met target prices while maintaining >50% volume commitment per existing contract.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pricing effective 1/1/2025; keeps prior contract framework with updated price matrix.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of shifting volume to Key Container; clear should-cost analysis.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher initial quotes, required multiple rounds to reach targets
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-qualification of box lines and case erector settings.

battlecards.why_selected: Competitive on specialty SKUs and maintains service levels; pricing brought within market range.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to reallocate volume to Key Container on non-competitive SKUs.
supplier_weaknesses: Minimal savings on one SKU (CB #7A showed slight cost increase)
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-certification of box specs and pallet programs.

battlecards.why_selected: Offered most competitive pricing on CB #5A and created leverage to drive incumbent concessions.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pricing live 12/13/2024; no minimum volume guarantees.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: New entrant willing to undercut incumbent pricing; used to pressure Unicorr/Rand.
battlecards.switching_costs: Pallet program alignment and inbound freight coordination.

battlecards.why_selected: Quoted 100% of RFQ items with best overall saving; agreed to volume-based rebate.
battlecards.contract_terms: Prices effective 1/1/2025; 2 % rebate once $1.25 M threshold met.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat to shift high-volume liner board to other bidders; market benchmark data.
supplier_weaknesses: Some items at parity (no savings on 3M tape)

battlecards.why_selected: Competitive on label items; minimal operational disruption.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to bundle label and thermal ribbon volumes.
supplier_weaknesses: Limited savings potential compared to Accutech
battlecards.switching_costs: Reconfiguring label printer formats if supplier changed.

battlecards.why_selected: Best all-in rate; agreed to 3-month pilot with no volume commitment and easy exit.
battlecards.contract_terms: Trial Jan-Mar 2025; option to extend to 2-year agreement with 90-day termination.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Competitive bids across 5 carriers; ability to route freight immediately after peak season.
supplier_weaknesses: No prior performance data with Christianbook
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – routing guide update and system carrier codes.
battlecards.notes: Savings based on linehaul + fuel versus OD historical costs.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not match Echo’s market pricing; existing rates 15-25% over benchmark.
battlecards.contract_terms: Legacy contract expires 2/28/2025; no minimum volume clauses.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of 100% volume shift to Echo after contract expiry.
battlecards.switching_costs: Carrier pickup relationships and EDI connections.

battlecards.why_selected: Delivered 4-8% lane savings and consistent bid across all high-volume lanes.
battlecards.contract_terms: Quarterly rate review; no fuel surcharge escalators outside DOE index.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Echo bid all-inclusive rates creating apples-to-apples comparison and pressure on incumbents.
battlecards.switching_costs: Carrier onboarding in TMS and updating routing guide.
battlecards.notes: Echo will be trialed concurrently for LTL & FTL to streamline freight under one 3PL.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Bid reflected price increases on Memphis lane; overall cost 3% higher than baseline.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Christianbook indicated zero future volume without competitive pricing.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Final proposal 11% above baseline; failed to clarify fuel schedule.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low – carrier codes deactivated in TMS.

summary.skipped_reason: Two suppliers (CHR, Coyote) lacked detailed cost or negotiation data; simple benchmark references only.

extraction_notes: Savings and spend figures taken from Final Close-Out report and detailed award slides.
Where supplier-specific baseline was available from itemized tables it was used; otherwise category baseline applied.
Peak Technologies final spend approximated by subtracting documented savings from item totals; figure rounded.
